invoker_invoke.name: Invoke
invoker_invoke.description:
The hero combines the elements of the active orbs to create a new spell. Cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_orb% sec. for each orb level. Grants an additional ability point at levels %first_ability_level%, %second_ability_level% and %third_ability_level%.

Press the list button to view all available spells.
invoker_invoke.lore: So begins a new age of knowledge.
invoker_invoke.note0: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
invoker_invoke.note1: Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
invoker_invoke.note2: Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

invoker_quas.name: Quas
invoker_quas.description: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
invoker_quas.note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
invoker_quas.note1: Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
invoker_quas.facet_invoker_quas_focus: <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> gains an additional level.

invoker_wex.name: Wex
invoker_wex.description: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
invoker_wex.note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
invoker_wex.note1: Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
invoker_wex.facet_invoker_wex_focus: <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> gains an additional level.

invoker_exort.name: Exort
invoker_exort.description: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_exort.note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
invoker_exort.note1: Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
invoker_exort.facet_invoker_exort_focus: <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> gains an additional level.

Press the list button to view all available spells.

invoker_invoke.note0: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
invoker_invoke.note1: Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
invoker_invoke.note2: Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

invoker_cold_snap.name: Cold Snap
invoker_cold_snap.description: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
invoker_cold_snap.note0: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.
invoker_cold_snap.facet_invoker_quas_focus: When Cold Snap triggers, Invoker is healed %freeze_heal% hp and restores %freeze_mana% mana.
invoker_cold_snap.ad_description: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases as the level goes up.
invoker_cold_snap.ad_note0: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.

invoker_ghost_walk.name: Ghost Walk
invoker_ghost_walk.description: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body transparent. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, and speeds up Invoker as well based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Can be dispelled. The ability is not interrupted by the hero's attacks or spells.
invoker_ghost_walk.note0: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.
invoker_ghost_walk.shard_description: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemies in a larger radius.
invoker_ghost_walk.ad_description: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies, and slows Invoker as well based on the level.
invoker_ghost_walk.ad_note0: The slow effect does not work on Debuff Immune enemies.

invoker_tornado.name: Tornado
invoker_tornado.description: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
invoker_tornado.note0: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.
invoker_tornado.scepter_description: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, dealing damage based on <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds. (half damage to creeps.)
invoker_tornado.ad_description: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level and holds enemies in the air for a duration.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
invoker_tornado.ad_note0: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

invoker_emp.ty1_description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.
invoker_emp.ty2_description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.
invoker_emp.name: E.M.P.
invoker_emp.description: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.
invoker_emp.facet_invoker_wex_focus: E.M.P. deals its damage again to all barriers.
invoker_emp.shard_description: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %drag_speed% units per second.
invoker_emp.note0: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
invoker_emp.ad_description: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.
invoker_emp.ad_note0: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
invoker_emp.ad_shard_description: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %shard_drag_speed% units per second.
invoker_emp.ty1_custom_description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.
invoker_emp.ty2_custom_description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.

invoker_alacrity.name: Alacrity
invoker_alacrity.description: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> and their damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_alacrity.facet_invoker_wex_focus: Alacrity grants bonus attack range when used on Invoker or any ranged units under his control.
invoker_alacrity.ad_description: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed and their damage.

invoker_chaos_meteor.name: Chaos Meteor
invoker_chaos_meteor.description: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, and rolling further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_chaos_meteor.facet_invoker_exort_focus: Chaos Meteor has %bonus_area_of_effect% bonus radius and %bonus_travel_distance% bonus travel distance.
invoker_chaos_meteor.note0: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
invoker_chaos_meteor.note1: The meteor moves at a speed of %travel_speed%.
invoker_chaos_meteor.ad_description: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage and rolling further based on the level. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time.
invoker_chaos_meteor.ad_note0: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
invoker_chaos_meteor.ad_note1: The meteor moves at a speed of %travel_speed%.

invoker_sun_strike.name: Sun Strike
invoker_sun_strike.description: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
invoker_sun_strike.scepter_description: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible %cataclysm_damage_pct%%% damage Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.
invoker_sun_strike.shard_description: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
invoker_sun_strike.note0: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
invoker_sun_strike.note1: Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
invoker_sun_strike.ad_description: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
invoker_sun_strike.ad_note0: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
invoker_sun_strike.ad_note1: Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
invoker_sun_strike.ad_scepter_description: Adds Cataclysm. Launched when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.

invoker_forge_spirit.name: Forge Spirit
invoker_forge_spirit.description: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. Spawns two spirits when Quas and Exort are at least level 4.
invoker_forge_spirit.note0: Summoning new spirits will destroy the old ones.
invoker_forge_spirit.ad_description: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes.
invoker_forge_spirit.ad_note0: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

invoker_ice_wall.name: Ice Wall
invoker_ice_wall.description: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and deals damage each second based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_ice_wall.scepter_description: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a %wall_width% width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than %root_delay% seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
invoker_ice_wall.ad_description: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies and deals damage each second.
invoker_ice_wall.ad_note0: The slow will still affect Debuff Immune enemies if their debuff immunity was created after being affected by Ice Wall.
invoker_ice_wall.note0: The slow will still affect Spell Immune enemies if their spell immunity was created after being affected by Ice Wall.

invoker_deafening_blast.name: Deafening Blast
invoker_deafening_blast.description: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
invoker_deafening_blast.ad_description: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration then disarm their attacks for a duration.
